memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: At that time the Lord said to me, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden ark. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the ark." So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands. - Deut 10:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After the disaster of the golden calf and the shattered tablets, we might expect God to walk away. Instead, He tells Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones." God would write His words again, giving His broken covenant a fresh start. The first tablets lay in pieces at the foot of the mountain, a monument to Israel's failure — and God, in mercy, provided a second set. This is the God we serve: the God of second chances.

There is deep comfort here for anyone who has failed. The broken tablets could have been the end of the story, but God's grace refused to let failure have the final word. He did not lower His standard — the same commandments were written again — but He renewed His commitment to a people who had broken faith with Him. Grace does not pretend the failure never happened; it provides a way forward in spite of it.

We all have "broken tablets" in our lives — moments of failure that seem to disqualify us. But God specializes in renewal. He is the One who restores what sin has shattered, who offers fresh starts to those who have fallen. This whole pattern points forward to the gospel, where God does far more than give a second set of stones. Through Christ, He writes His law on our hearts and makes us new creations (2 Cor 5:17). Whatever lies broken behind you, God's mercy offers a way forward. Bring your failures to Him, and receive His grace to begin again.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What "broken tablets" in my life feel like they disqualify me?
- How does God's giving of a second set of tablets reveal His heart toward me?
- Where do I need to receive God's grace for a fresh start today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You are the God of second chances, who restores what sin has shattered. When I feel disqualified by my failures, remind me that Your grace offers a way forward. Make me new, and help me begin again in You. Amen.
